intervals.local_calendar_day: local midnight through next local midnight; actual 23/24/25 elapsed hours
intervals.rolling_24_hours: 24 complete native hourly accumulation intervals with named UTC endpoints
intervals.remaining_day: complete future native hours after ceil(issue) through local midnight; excludes the ongoing partial hour

source_semantics.means: sum complete disjoint native mean depths for one head/run/cell only
source_semantics.quantiles: retain individual hourly statistics; reject sums of marginal quantiles
source_semantics.availability: retain actual acquisition/publication clocks; historical-assumed experiment remains separate from issued skill

decision_selection: latest original decision completing before the target interval starts; choose before checking three-head missingness or outcomes; no replacement with an earlier successful issue

observation.source: original Weather_Rain_Evidence_JSON counter receipts with native continuity/barrier/epoch/policy/cutover checks
observation.uncertainty: retain native counter boundary lower/upper range, expand classification ambiguity by one independently evidenced resolution step
observation.resolution: requires source-bound independently evidenced measurement resolution and actual availability; decoder/reference specifications alone do not grant local resolution evidence

classification.wet: lower uncertainty bound at or above the declared wet-event threshold
classification.below_threshold: upper uncertainty bound strictly below threshold; trace is not asserted to be physically dry
classification.ambiguous: uncertainty interval crosses threshold; exclude from occurrence class fitting/scoring, retain continuous-depth diagnostics

baselines.raw: all three heads on exactly the same complete targets
baselines.incumbent: current provider total_precipitation_1hr; preserve any original serving selection/model identity if present
baselines.gain: existing target-weighted fit_gain rain_24h_mm procedure, training only

candidate.occurrence: weighted ridge logistic IRLS; fixed L2=1, intercept unpenalized, maximum25iterations, tolerance1e-8
candidate.positive_amount: ridge regression of log(observed_mm-wet_threshold_mm), fixed L2=1, intercept unpenalized; training-only smearing yields conditional mean above threshold
candidate.subthreshold_amount: training-only weighted mean for unambiguously below-threshold targets; do not silently turn measurable trace into zero
candidate.source_label: local learned experimental interval forecast; not native Google probabilities
candidate.cumulative_probability: only for the exactly trained interval target; never sum hourly probabilities or quantiles

support.wet_event_definition: consecutive wet daily target intervals form one event; a qualified below-threshold interval separates events; gaps do not establish independence
support.independence: one original per target; equal local target dates; no overlapping-window sample inflation
support.cohort: interval kind, lead scope, original native grid, gauge policy/resolution/source epoch and evidence-availability class

split: rolling chronological; final third of eligible independent target dates is outer holdout; all fitted inputs actually available before each decision; no outer tuning

metrics.timing: hourly native three-head timing versus qualified hourly counter brackets where supported; no fabricated intrainterval local-model timing

selection.bootstrap: 500 fixed-seed independent local-day-block resamples; paired origins stay together
selection.gate: candidate must improve both Brier versus training-only climatology and matched amount error versus incumbent/gain with wet-event support; dry-only aggregate gains cannot select
selection.raw_head_selection: inner-date ranking only, outer verification on same complete targets; no automatic production changes
